decisions.reason: Its dedicated webpage and multiple models represent high sunk costs and strong public commitment, making management very unlikely to abandon it.

Although only briefly mentioned on the website, the product builds directly on the firm's established offer and has already absorbed development resources, so escalation of commitment argues for keeping it.
Because it is close to the established offer and has an existing web presence, management has sunk costs that justify continuing the service despite limited visibility.
The product line with several models implies substantial prior investment and public commitment, and discontinuing it would abandon those resources.
The public launch announcement and its proximity to the established offer create visible commitment and sunk costs that make withdrawal improbable.
